# Put your PICO-8 archive here

Download `pico-8_<version>_raspi.zip` from your Lexaloffle account
(<https://www.lexaloffle.com/games.php?page=updates>) and drop it in this directory.

The build reads it from here and installs the binary into the image.

**It is deliberately not committed.** PICO-8 is proprietary, per-user licensed software. It
must not be added to this repository, and an image containing it must not be given to anyone
else. Every person who builds this needs their own PICO-8 licence. See
[../../docs/licensing.md](../../docs/licensing.md).
